about_short_description.short_description: StreamCoin is the Governance Mainnet Coin emerging as a token for the StreamCoin ecosystem.

product.name: Stream Chain 2.0
product.description: A standalone mainnet focused on security, decentralization, and versatility, compatible with Ethereum Virtual Machine (EVM) for easier porting of smart contracts and Dapps.

product.name: StreamCoin (STRM)
product.description: A governance mainnet coin used for off-chain staking, NFT minting, donations, and on-chain staking within the StreamCoin ecosystem.

product.name: MeiTalk
product.description: A global multi-streaming platform that supports streaming to 80+ platforms, offers real-time auto-translation, live interactions, personalized search filters, and crypto rewards.

product.name: AngryMonky Marketplace
product.description: An NFT marketplace for creating, collecting, and trading digital collectibles with features like multiple chain support, decentralized wallet management, and free minting.

product.name: Stream Bridge
product.description: A swapping service that allows STRM holders to move their tokens between different blockchains, enhancing liquidity for trading on decentralized exchanges.

product.name: Real Research
product.description: A platform where companies can use StreamCoin and GaStream as cryptocurrency incentives for users completing surveys, promoting market adoption.
